title: Expanded OBS card is capped at max-height 46rem and clipped by clip-path, so rows can be cut off at phone widths
test: Browser measurement, no repository test added: `vite build --outDir` of lane/libmisc at 1be0088 into the scratchpad, served by server.js on 3210 (NODE_ENV=test, NEXTRA_SMOKE_TEST=1, NEXTRA_TEST_DIST_DIR) under the Playwright lock, measured with Playwright's Chromium by scratch scripts libmisc-check15-measure.cjs (rendered height, computed max-height, hit test of #obsPassword; desktop and isMobile contexts) and libmisc-check15-natural.cjs (natural height with max-height lifted). Runs: 19 widths 320-1279 x heights 800/932/1440/2000; phone page-zoom viewports (360, 390 and 412 px phones at 125-200%); browser default font 20 and 24 px; WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing overrides. Every case also with the optional 'Disabled for public sharing' AV1 hint added, the tallest content the card can show
proof: The claim does not hold. At the widths it names (320-400px) the expanded card's natural height is 358-624px against the 736px (46rem) cap, so it is never capped: 320px gives 358 (568 tall), 442 (800), 504 (932) and 568px (1440 or taller, where the vh-clamped row padding stops growing), 624px with the extra hint; 360-414px give 379-555px. The 900-1279px tier (card 19rem = 304px wide) peaks at the same 568/624px. #obsPassword, the last control, was the hit-test target in every case, desktop and isMobile. The claim's mechanism is also off: `.setting-row-inline` going to one column below 640px does not touch this card, because `.settings-panel .setting-row-inline` (src/index.css 630-634, higher specificity) already stacks its only inline row at every width; the card has a heading and four rows, and the AV1 row's second hint is its only optional content. The cap (src/index.css 2029-2032) and the clip (overflow: clip at 706, clip-path at 2037) are as described, so content taller than 46rem would be cut, but that needs conditions well outside the claim: a CSS viewport about 180-195px wide (a 360-390px phone at 200% page zoom; 9-11px of bottom padding cut, 138px with the public-share hint at 180x400), a 24px browser default font at 320px (47px cut at 320x800 with the hint), or WCAG text spacing at 320x1440 with the hint (12.5px, inside the 21.6px bottom padding, no row cut). At 125-175% page zoom on those phones, at 20px default font, and with text spacing at real phone heights, nothing is cut. Same on the original code: `git diff ac1c688 HEAD -- src/index.css` changes only the :root stage tokens, .video-container, .watch-video and one comment, and the settings-wrapper JSX in src/HostView.jsx is identical (134 lines, diff empty), so the card's size and clip are unchanged since then. No file changed.
